description: Cumulative composition: the existing joint-supply source_path theorem extracts an actual concrete source of the selected grounding relation from an adequately supplied actual concrete candidate. The existing contingent-root conversion and no-contingent-root equivalence show that this source must be necessary if all actual contingent concreta are grounded. Explicit excluded middle supplies the positive modal witness. Thus jointly retaining source-backed existential supply and contingent dependence excludes an entirely contingent account, regardless of its cardinality or local coherence. No blanket global well-foundedness or fresh necessary-witness premise is added. The application of Supply and the contingent-dependence principle remain philosophical commitments, not consequences of the Lean proof. No unity, permanent underivedness, self-explanation or God identification follows.
